title: Benchmark Generalization Gap Probe: Testing Whether High Benchmark Scores Reflect Overfitting

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If safety benchmarks measure memorization rather than genuine robustness, the entire evaluation paradigm is undermined. The 57.2pp gap already observed makes this hypothesis highly credible. Directly challenges the validity of leaderboard-driven safety claims.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Two-split evaluation with LLM-based paraphrasing is straightforward. Using an LLM to generate novel prompts from existing ones requires only API access. Running attack evaluations on both splits is standard. Accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: generalization gap score for 3-5 models. Two splits, same evaluation pipeline. The paraphrasing step adds work but the methodology is clean. Feasible within 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
